title: GateApiError
description: Error body returned by the gate endpoints. The code identifies the error. The message is text for people and does not include payload bodies, nonces or signatures. Statuses: not_found 404, already_decided 409, verification_failed 403, invalid_request 400 (413 over 1 MiB, 422 for an edited intent the schemas or the original's kind refuse), unauthenticated 401 (no valid session cookie on a gated phone route), step_up_required 403 (an elevated phone route without a fresh step-up from the session's passkey in the last five minutes), misdirected_request 421 (a Host header the listener does not serve), unsupported_media_type 415 (a phone-listener POST whose Content-Type is not application/json), tier_changed 409 and forbidden 403 (an edit refused by policy), unavailable 500, busy 503 (the gate refused a mail read at its concurrent-read limit, with a Retry-After header), handshake_failed 502 (Proton Bridge refused the connection or the TLS handshake) and auth_failed 502 (Bridge refused the username or password). The file-root errors name the folder by rootId, the id the owner gave it, never a path or OS text: root_missing 422 (POST /file-roots/prepare: the file helper could not identify the folder) and root_changed 409 (POST /file-roots/complete: the folder's canonical path or identity changed since prepare, or it is gone; nothing was stored). The admin routes (#659) relay the stack supervisor: supervisor_unavailable 503 (its socket did not answer), supervisor_failed 502 (it refused or answered outside its schema), stack_not_running 409 (a restart or model change while core and llama are stopped), busy 503 (another job or fetch is running), and unsupported_platform 501 (start at login needs launchd, on macOS only so far). The connector secret routes (#661): pin_mismatch 409 (a Bridge password for a pin the gate does not run with), certificate_mismatch 409 (a new Bridge pin the configured certificate file does not match), claim_failed 502 (bridge.simplefin.org refused or did not answer the setup token's claim; the token may be spent). The Google sign-in start routes (#662) answer client_secret_required 400 when the vault holds no OAuth secret for the client and the request carries none.
